The '''Cultural Center''' was located in [[Tasariq City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. The building contained a [[Library/Legends|library]], a [[Museum/Legends|museum]], and the [[Tasari Hall of Culture]]. The Cultural Center also housed the offices of the [[Imperial Board of Culture]].<ref name="J15" />
